They are the highest class of society in this world and make up the upper class. The weaker, submissive, and less masculine men become the "Slaves" or "Servants". They are the lowest class of society in this world and make up the lower class. Between these two classes lie many others that serve various functions such as soldiers, magicians, merchants, artisans, etc. This world has its own set of social rules that differ from those of modern-day earth. For example, in this world, men can get pregnant just like women can. All people in this world must abide by these rules, regardless of whether they were born into it or not. This world is full of magic and supernatural powers. Its laws of nature are very different from our own. The physical appearance of men in this world also differs greatly compared to what we know today; they tend to have taller bodies with larger penises on average than normal human males do. This is due to genetic engineering carried out centuries ago when humans first began inhabiting this planet after migrating from other planets across space through hyperspace portals for survival reasons during an ice age on Earth millions of years ago (The Age Before Humans). These engineered features allowed males here to reproduce more successfully while still having enough energy left over after reproduction cycles finished up each day so that males wouldn's die off quickly because they lacked adequate food sources during periods when resources weren't plentiful due to climate changes occurring over time.
